# Richard Cummings — Professional Profile

## Professional Summary
Richard Cummings is an IT Asset & Configuration Leader with over 15 years of experience in IT operations, service delivery, and logistics across global enterprises. He specialises in IT Asset Management (ITAM), Configuration Management Databases (CMDB), hardware provisioning, and vendor SLA management for MSP environments supporting 20,000+ end-users. Alongside his operational career he founded and launched UsePathly.com — an AI-powered SaaS career platform — entirely solo, from strategy and UX design through to AI integration and live paying customers.

## Career History (most recent first)

### Asset and Configuration Lead — Ekco Cloud & Security (Global MSP)
Dec 2025 – Apr 2026
Led a team of 8 (Logistics Specialists, Build Engineers, Asset & Configuration Manager, Endpoint & Applications Managers). Owned full ITAM, CMDB governance, stock logistics, hardware provisioning, and user onboarding for 20,000+ external end-users. Led end-to-end migration from AssetTrac to FreshService CMDB. Managed vendor SLAs and implemented user onboarding automation.

### Founder & Product Lead — UsePathly.com
Jul 2025 – Present
Founded and launched UsePathly.com, an AI-driven B2C SaaS career platform with 25+ AI-powered tools (ATS-optimised Resume Builder, Skill Gap Analysis, Interview Preparation, LinkedIn Optimiser, and more). Built entirely solo. Live with paying customers. Pricing: free tier + £11/month premium.

### Service Delivery Coordinator — Ekco Cloud & Security (Global MSP)
Jun 2025 – Nov 2025
Owned hardware provisioning lifecycle from build and configuration to client dispatch. Worked daily in FreshService and ServiceNow. Maintained IT asset inventories and coordinated between technical teams, suppliers, and clients for SLA compliance.

### Operations Controller — Biffa Waste
Nov 2023 – May 2025
Reduced customer churn from 14.5% to 3.8% — 68% better than the national depot average. Achieved through data analysis, driver schedule optimisation, and service improvements.

### Operations Manager — Biffa Waste
Feb 2022 – Oct 2023
Led a team of 6 transport managers with full P&L ownership. Drove customer satisfaction and business growth in a competitive logistics sector.

### Lead Account Manager — Yusen Logistics
Jan 2021 – Feb 2022
Managed a £5.2 million portfolio and led a team of 4 international transport managers. Improved NPS by 15% in 6 months. Key accounts included Pfizer and Moderna.

### Independent Logistics Consultant — Freelance
May 2018 – Dec 2020
Advised SMBs on operational streamlining. Implemented Paradigm Routing SaaS software for logistics optimisation.

### Head of Logistics & Regional Manager — Furniture Village
Aug 2014 – Apr 2018
Managed 31-person transport team, 18 depots, full budget ownership. £1M+ revenue contribution. CSAT 4.5/5 from 7,200+ B2C customers.
